findings.message: The audio track 1 holds protected enca (encrypted audio), whose samples are not analyzed yet.
The samples of the audio track 1 are encrypted (Common Encryption, AES-CTR (cenc)), so their frames are not read; the stream is described by its sample entry and sample tables.
The sinf box of the enca sample entry at 0x19D has no frma box, so the original format is not stated (ISO/IEC 14496-12 8.12.1).
